title: 📸 Photo Quest: Ballard Park
description:
See the Space Coast through a new lens.
Join the IRL Club for an evening photography challenge where everyone receives the same themed shot list before heading out to explore. Whether you're using a smartphone, mirrorless camera, or DSLR, the goal isn't to take the "perfect" photo—it's to see how differently each person interprets the same prompts.
From surprising angles to hidden textures and unexpected details, you'll have the chance to slow down, notice your surroundings, and get creative.
After the challenge, we'll head to a nearby restaurant/bar for an optional casual dinner to share stories, compare photos, and see how everyone approached the same shot list. You'll also be invited to share your images in the IRL Club Discord gallery after the event so everyone can revisit the challenge and continue the conversation.
Your ticket includes:
📋 A themed Photo Quest challenge sheet
📸 A guided photography challenge
💬 Post-event social meetup
🖼️ Access to the IRL Club Discord community to share your photos
Details:
📱 All cameras are welcome, including smartphones
🍽️ Optional dinner after the event (food and drinks purchased separately)
No photography experience is required—just bring your camera, your curiosity, and a willingness to explore!
